Game Overview

Hand Doctor is a girls' title where step into the role of a skilled hand doctor and treat six unique patients with specialized injuries. Navigate realistic medical scenarios with intuitive click-and-drag controls. Delight in vibrant HD graphics and dramatic soundscapes as you stitch wounds, fix fractures, and master the art of hand healing.
